1.consolidated_definition: educ. Receso de primavera. Vacaciones cortas que las escuelas y universidades ofrecen durante determinados días de la primavera. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. “En parte ha sido porque muchos colegios privados tienen libre después de Semana Santa, y eso se junta con las dos semanas de spring break”, dijo (El Nuevo Día, 25-05-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Spring break (educ.). A brief recess in the spring. Short vacations offered by schools and universities during specific days of spring. Anglicism, often used. "In part it has been because many private colleges have a break after Holy Week, and that combines with two weeks of spring break," said (El Nuevo Día, 25-05-07)
